gold: Cranial nerve 7 (CN7) paresis secondary to acute bacterial sinusitis

selector.rationale: Rhinosinusitis best explains the findings of purulent nasal secretions, polypoid changes of the right middle turbinate, and purulence within the nasal cavity, as well as the CT scan findings of an orbital abscess extending from right-sided rhinosinusitis.

rejected.label: Cavernous sinus thrombosis
rejected.why: Lack of specific findings supporting this diagnosis, such as filling defects in the cavernous sinus on imaging

rejected.label: Cavernous sinus syndrome
rejected.why: Less specific than Rhinosinusitis and Orbital cellulitis, with fewer supporting findings

rejected.label: Coagulase-negative Staphylococcus aureus infection
rejected.why: While cultures grew this organism, the clinical presentation is more consistent with Rhinosinusitis and Orbital cellulitis
